Yes, capturing the search text and included tag chips together matches what I meant; using `NOT #tag` inside the saved search is a clear way to preserve exclusions. The collection should remain dynamic, so opening it later shows whatever bookmarks match at that time rather than freezing today’s results.

The chips under the main view tabs feel like the right home. They’re easy to reuse without confusing them with the fixed All, To read, and Archived views.
